sources.entry: Claude Code - Anthropic's terminal-native AI coding agent with agent skills, MCP, and extensible tool system. #freemium

summary.name: Claude Code
summary.one_liner: Anthropic's agentic coding tool that reads a codebase, edits files, runs commands, and integrates with development tools across terminal, IDE, desktop, and web surfaces.
use_cases: scheduled PR reviews and dependency audits
summary.what_it_does: Claude Code is a terminal-based coding agent that can read a project, edit files across multiple locations, run shell commands, and verify its changes. It works directly with git to stage changes, write commit messages, create branches, and open pull requests. It can connect to external tools and data sources through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Customization is supported through a CLAUDE.md instructions file, shareable skills, hooks that run shell commands around actions, and multiple parallel or custom agents built with the Agent SDK. The same engine is offered across the terminal, VS Code, JetBrains, a desktop app, and the web.
notable: Same engine across terminal, IDE, desktop, and web surfaces, sharing CLAUDE.md, settings, and MCP servers
Scheduled cloud and desktop tasks plus Remote Control and Dispatch from a phone
Hooks and skills for repeatable workflows and automatic formatting or linting
Agent SDK for building custom agents
caveats: Most surfaces require a Claude subscription or Anthropic Console account
Teleport and /desktop handoff require a claude.ai subscription
Desktop handoff is available on macOS and x64 Windows only
Git for Windows is recommended on native Windows; otherwise PowerShell is used as the shell
